_comment: Canonical-symbol manifest — DECISION-canonical-ownership rule 4 / action #7. Lists capabilities owned by another repo (or by a designated FPA module) whose re-implementation inside this repo must fail the pre-commit/smoke gate. Enforced by scripts/check-canonical-symbols.py. Changing ownership means editing THIS file — a visible diff, not a quiet fork.
